5. Collateral and Loan-to-Value (LTV)
For secured loans, the Loan-to-Value ratio must not exceed 80% of the appraised collateral value. Loans
with no collateral above INR 1,000,000 require mandatory human approval regardless of credit score.
6. Default History
Any applicant with a prior bank default or written-off loan in the last 5 years is automatically flagged High
Risk and requires senior underwriter sign-off before any approval can be issued.

Credit Risk Assessment Guidelines
1. Risk Classification Framework
Every application must be classified into one of three risk bands: LOW, MEDIUM, or HIGH. The
classification drives the routing decision in the agentic workflow (auto-recommend path vs. mandatory
manual review path).
2. LOW Risk Criteria (all must be true)
Credit score >= 700 AND DTI ratio <= 0.35 AND no prior default history AND employment tenure >= 1
year. LOW risk applications may proceed on the fast-track / expedited router path.
3. MEDIUM Risk Criteria
Credit score between 650 and 699, OR DTI ratio above 0.35 and up to 0.50, OR employment tenure below
1 year, with no default history. MEDIUM risk applications follow the standard sequential path with full
risk-agent analysis and require branch-manager human approval.
